reviews.title: Unlimited Number of Daily Goals in a Free Tracker

reviews.title: Perfect App!
reviews.text: I’ve been in search for a straight-forward, easy to use habit tracker app, and I’ve been so thankful to find this app! It’s all free, with no limits to the amount of habits you can create, statistics are always accessible, and no annoying pop-ups attempting to persuade you to “buy premium” or anything of the sort. If you just want a good app for tracking habits on a daily/weekly basis, I couldn’t recommend this one enough! I’m very happy with this download, this app is all I needed and I appreciate the developers making it free for all.

reviews.title: Dark Mode + tiny bug
reviews.text:
please Please PLEASE make a dark version!!! A night mode !!
I have used this app for about a month and love the simplicity. I sit down every night and go through my habits. It’s truly wonderful — and the only thing I would want is a dark mode so my eyes don’t hurt.

Also, there’s a small bug on the last day of each month where I’m unable to track my habits directly on the day. I don’t remember specifics, but I believe it opens the wrong day. I usually just go to the calendar and manually input my habits there.
Thanks for your time!

reviews.title: Great App. Ideas for Improvement
reviews.text: I like this app a lot because it is ad and subscription free. I do wish I could customize the habits a bit further by either leaving notes or setting custom intervals for each habit (x times daily, weekly, monthly, etc). I’d also like to be able to customize the view to track overall habit progress.  A grid view option for monthly and yearly would be nice in addition to the current progress graph in statistics.
